subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this stay as a core Gateway protocol/auth investigation, or should maintainers split the Trim OS app-manager config rewrite to package ownership while asking for the sanitized connect frame and Gateway log here?
rationale: The source-backed 1002 path is protocol negotiation, but the requested workaround touches Gateway device pairing and shared-auth boundaries, and the alleged config rewrite may not live in this repository.

options.title: Collect proof before auth changes
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the connect frame minProtocol/maxProtocol/client version, exact package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a core or package fix.

options.title: Split package ownership
options.body: Keep protocol mismatch diagnosis here but route the Trim OS config-regeneration behavior to the package owner if that code is outside this repository.

options.title: Core diagnostics/docs repair
options.body: If logs show a current OpenClaw client speaking the wrong protocol or producing opaque diagnostics, fix the Gateway/CLI diagnostic path without loosening pairing.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before auth changes
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway logs, the connect frame minProtocol/maxProtocol/client version, exact package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing a core or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest available routing signal across the recent Gateway protocol and device-pairing surface, though local history is shallow.
